system.description:
Requirements: Mountain King Style, Training (3) and Expertise (3) in Melee Weapons or Ranged Weapons, 5 abilities with the Mountain King Style trait, and you must receive training from a master of this style, or have access to their teachings

Cost: 3 Focus

Range: Self

Your blows can literally shatter the earth.

As an Action, spend 3 Focus and make a Melee or Ranged Weapon attack against one creature within range. The attack has Advantage, the Damage it deals is doubled, and the target must make an opposed Resilience check, or be Stunned until the start of your next turn.

You may choose to end Mountain King Style after you perform this ability: if you do, the attack has Greater Advantage and all enemies within 1 Space of the target must make an opposed Resilience Check or be knocked Prone.
